scope: Full libghostty-vt compatibility; native app/font/GPU validation is separate.
rules: Thorough may pass only when every requirement is complete, exported by both adapters and exercised by passing cases.
A smoke pass is not a full-parity claim. Snapshot comparison alone is insufficient.

requirements.remaining: Control-sequence cases and upstream fuzz corpus have not all been ported.
Row prompt metadata and OSC 133 redraw policies are compared across resize and snapshots; complete reflow, height changes, scrollback pruning and tracked-reference cases remain.

Mode/cursor defaults, saved bits, color persistence, RIS, and direct-reset continuation through UTF-8/ESC/CSI/OSC/DCS/APC including capture limits are compared; graphics and other reset state still need complete coverage.
Mode saved/default state, colors and cursor/mouse transition effects are optionally observed; saved cursor, viewport and complete continuation remain.
Cell comparison exists; ECH/EL/DCH wrap resets, next-row continuation and wide spacer cleanup have focused snapshot coverage. Complete grapheme, protection, wide-cell and semantic cases remain.

Live STYLE admission, cursor/cell references, dead-ID reuse, rehash/growth, restored sparse IDs, resize and mixed-width IND copies have bounded coverage. The native max-capacity split cursor-cache defect is repaired and its six retained comparisons pass. Native and Rust narrow-page mutation now agree across 96 first-IND and continued-printing comparisons. Complete SGR/state transitions and resource-exhaustion combinations remain.
Both screens/history are observed; complete screen-switch behavior remains.
Cursor shape, visibility/blink and configured reset defaults are compared; saved cursor and all motion cases remain.
Host query decisions, mode reports and xterm/Kitty color replies are compared; disabled PTY writes and complete control contexts remain.

Raw bytes, UTF-8 validation before truncation, fixed capture/prefix behavior, direct setters and snapshot restoration are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Opaque raw bytes, OSC7/ConEmu/iTerm2 aliases, fixed capture/prefix behavior, uncapped setters and snapshots are compared; disabled callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
BEL callback is observed; parser contexts and notification interaction remain.
All 1,112,064 valid Unicode scalar widths are compared; invalid scalar boundaries are rejected. Grapheme composition is tracked under terminal.cells.

Raw parser/UTF-8 events and inherited parser corpora are compared; exhaustive transition/boundary combinations and capture-limit behavior remain. Raw OSC observation does not validate command semantics.

Validated title/PWD, color, notification and clipboard semantics plus fixed capture/prefix cases are compared. Native OSC 66/99 deliberately unimplemented terminal callbacks are verified as no-ops across payload/capture boundaries, malformed input and continuation. Remaining OSC commands, typed metadata APIs, streaming capture allocation and complete malformed contexts remain.

All current source modes, raw saved/default bits, guarded reset policy, DECRQM and basic stream/mouse/cursor transitions are compared; complete cross-mode interactions and screen/input behavior remain.

Current/default/override state, all palette indices, native X11 names, RGB/intensity parsing and xterm/Kitty reply matrices are compared; intermediate capture/continuation, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.

Direct bounds/text, rectangles, wide/grapheme cells and whitespace/wrap cases pass. Pure word, word-between, line, all and output queries pass 384 comparisons across 128 fixtures. All ten selection-end adjustments pass 450 comparisons across 150 fixtures, including reversed/rectangular endpoints, blank and written-space rows, wide spacers, history, alternate screens and mixed physical widths. Plain/VT/HTML selection export with all trim/unwrap combinations passes 363 comparisons across 121 fixtures. Gesture press/drag/release, repeats, deep press and autoscroll pass 1221 comparisons across 407 cell/word/line/output fixtures, including reset/pruned anchors. Complete mutation lifetimes, formatter coordinate maps and full terminal-state exports remain.

Literal bytes, ASCII folding, formatter coordinates, page order/overlap/trimming and no-scrollback prefix pruning are compared without normalization. Persistent viewport feeds and cached reads are covered. Full-history feed/tick, indexed results, selected-match retention/fallback and wrapping, screen switches, pruning, resize, reset, snapshot prepend and restored-width edits pass 612 comparisons across 204 fixtures, including viewport-pin reflow and cached history after same-width movement. Owned search pins expire on drop; ticks read no terminal state. The repaired native short-window case remains in all 237 page-search comparisons. Complete resource-driven mutation lifetimes and regex extension coverage remain.

Page/resource capacity and offset arithmetic, column adjustment and pooled/exact allocation charge are compared on macOS ARM64 without backing allocations. Page lifetime, splitting, retained resource entries, fragmentation, reflow inheritance and other platform ABIs remain.

Initialization, growth, whole-page pruning, clear/reset, dimension changes, reflow and snapshot admission compare native boundaries, capacities and allocation charges on macOS ARM64. Live STYLE ownership, growth and mixed-width row copies have bounded coverage. Native STYLE splits and narrow-page mutations are repaired; Rust follows corrected growth, padding and cursor metadata across 96 mixed-width comparisons. Other managed resources, splitting during reflow, compression and complete lifecycle combinations remain.

Live coordinates/codepoints are compared through reflow, erasure, resets, handle reuse and screen switches. Owner isolation, reset lifetime, inactive release, line shifts and alternate/history pin motion pass; rebinding, exact pruning and snapshot restoration remain.

Stored IDs, dimensions and RGBA pixels for raw/PNG/zlib uploads on both screens are compared. Tagged placement keys, requested/source/pixel/grid geometry, zero pixel sizes, ordinary cursor/display/deletion/retransmission, basic history/reflow/screen/reset lifecycle and simple parent-orphan/virtual-clear cases are compared. Ordinary relative-parent choice, validation/error precedence, eight-link chains and per-link saturated offsets pass 192 comparisons across 64 fixtures. Unicode placeholder runs, all reference diacritics, ID inheritance, explicit/fallback targets, and basic viewport lifecycle pass 1,029 comparisons; shared renderer tests cover virtual-root minimum origins. Rounded placeholder geometry, complete margin clipping, pruning, virtual-root viewport edges, transports and animation with deterministic clocks remain.

Real bounded Wuffs decoding and stored pixels are compared across color types/depths, transparency, Adam7, truncation, checksums and dimension precedence; APNG, ancillary chunks and complete resource/error limits remain.

Headless glyf uploads, exact outlines/design/constraints, ordered replacement/eviction, replies, dirty state, configured capture and decoder limits, and snapshot continuation/omission are compared; font coverage, visible rasterization and allocator-failure injection remain.

OSC 52/5522 metadata, binary reads/writes, MIME filtering, streamed base64, aliases, statuses, callback absence, configured limits, session grants, one-time paste grants and exact 8 MiB OSC capture boundaries are compared; OSC 1337, allocation failures and complete size limits remain.

OSC 72 metadata, registration/status chunks, callback-time state, host move/drop/leave, binary data replies, local-only errors, MIME/item limits, exact 8 MiB capture boundaries, direct-reset capture continuation and snapshot omission are compared. Allocation failures and direct utility APIs remain.
All named keys in the native legacy/Kitty tables, text fallback, IME, modifier-side bits and macOS Option policies are compared; host event mapping and complete text/control combinations remain.
All mouse modes/formats, buttons and viewport/pixel cases pass; retained motion deduplication, renderer padding and full coordinate-limit cases remain.

Focus, binary paste encodings, safety checks, mode precedence, Kitty paste events, one-time grants, lazy readers and entropy/read errors are compared; disabled output callbacks, allocation failures and complete control contexts remain.
Current source terminfo capabilities, host-specified names and DECRQSS styles/margins/cursor replies pass; all control contexts and resource limits remain.

OSC9/777 notification bytes, ConEmu classification/progress/fresh prompts, fixed captures and explicit host query decisions are compared. Native OSC 99 has no notification callback or replies, including multipart/query/close messages; that unsupported behavior is verified. Disabled callback combinations remain.

Both encodings and uninterrupted continuation are compared; PAGE STYLE/LINK admission, hyperlink string lifetimes/deduplication and linked-cell limits have bounded coverage. The native short-bitmap allocation failure is repaired; all 660 hyperlink resource comparisons pass. Complete metadata, lazy mixed-width PAGEs and all state transitions remain.

READY/history/FINISH state and source offsets are compared with live mutations and transport tails. Width changes away/back, permanent discard after a skipped PAGE, reset, alternate-screen recreation, height changes and limits pass 78 comparisons. Complete mutation-policy combinations, continuation replay and I/O failures remain.

Complete-v1, every truncation, selected corruptions, exact-decode tails, terminal/screen metadata fallbacks and malformed record structure are compared. Shared continuation decode budgets and later live capture are checked through full/exact/ready APIs; Rust regressions retain normal capture under tiny and raised import budgets, and reader/writer failures at record boundaries. Native cursor bounds are repaired and 45 mixed-width cursor comparisons pass. Allocation-failure injection, remaining component fields and complete mixed PAGE transitions need coverage.
All inherited corpora, deterministic mixed operations, invariants and minimized regressions.
